 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur

sentences.text:
Apprehending the arrest at the hands of police in connection with
Crime No.449/2024 registered with Police Station Beltarodi, Nagpur for the offence punishable
under Section 420, 467 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code, the applicant approached to this Court
for grant of pre-arrest bail.

2.  The allegations levelled against the present applicant is on the basis of report lodged by one Sandhya Pradip Salve on an allegation that her father was the exclusive owner of agriculture field bearing city Survey No.60, Mouja Beltarodi, total admeasuring 0.81 H.R.
After his death the names of her brothers as well as her name and other legal heirs were mutated in the 7/12 extract.

The informant's mother and brother namely Sulochana and Rajendra respectively, sold the 0.40 H.R.
land out of above mentioned land at Beltarodi to 'Mamta Co-operative Housing Society Limited,
Nagpur', vide registered sale- deed dated 16/04/1991 for valuable consideration of Rs. 50,000/-,
without her consent and other legal heirs of deceased.

entities.text:
Mamta Co-operative Housing Society Limited,
Nagpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is further alleged that while executing the above said sale-deed bogus relinquishment deed dated 15/1/1991 was prepared in respect of their share in favour of mother - Sulochana and brother - Rajendra.

It is further alleged that the applicant who is the President of the Mamta Co-operative Housing Society has executed the sale-deed in respect of above mentioned 0.40 H.R. in favour of Sachin Borkar and thereby she was deprived from her legal rights and she is duped.
On the basis of said report, police have registered the crime against the present applicant.

3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as the present applicant is concerned who is the Chairman of the said society has only accepted the documents and thereafter executed the sale-deed.
He is not at all concerned with the forgery of the relinquishment deed which was prior to the handing over the said land to the society.
In view of that, the custodial interrogation of the present applicant is not required, therefore, he be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

Learned APP strongly opposed the said application on the ground that considering the nature of the offence wherein it is alleged that relinquishment deed is forged.
The custodial interrogation of the applicant is required.
In view of that, prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be rejected.
5. I have heard learned Counsel for both the parties.
Perused the recitals of the FIR from which it reveals that prior to handing over the possession of the 0.40 R land to the society, his relinquishment deed was executed.
Thus, as far as the forgery of the document is concerned admittedly, applicant is not concerned with the same.
The entire case is revolves around the documentary evidence.
In view of that, the custodial interrogation of the present applicant immediately is not required, and therefore, applicant has made out a case for grant of ad- interim protection.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following order:
(i) Issue notice to the non-applicant, returnable after two weeks.
(ii) Learned APP waives notice for the State and seeks time to file reply.

(iii) In the event of the arrest, the applicant - Shri Manish s/o Anandwardhan Trivedi in connection with Crime No.449/2024 registered with Police Station Beltarodi, Nagpur for the offence punishable under Section 420, 467 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code, be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail on executing P.R. bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(iv) The applicant shall attend the  concerned police station as and when required for the investigation purpose and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
(v) The applicant shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who are acquainted with the facts of the case.

(URMILA JOSHI-PHALKE, J.) *Divya Shri Manish S/O Anandwardhan Trivedi vs The State Of Maharashtra Thr. Pso, Ps, ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100669935/
